name: 固定的置中直排文字＋兩側交錯經過的直式圖片
desc: 一段直排文字固定在畫面中央，多張直式圖片左右交錯、由下往上從文字兩側捲動經過，最後一張經過後解除固定。
prompt: 建立一個高度約四個畫面的區塊，捲動時其中一欄固定在畫面上，另一欄正常捲動經過：中央的文字固定，兩側的圖片正常捲動經過。區塊上部放一整段直排文字：多行直書由右往左並排，合成一個寬的文字塊，約佔頁面內容寬度的三到四成，水平大致置中，沒有標題與按鈕；文字塊的高度約佔畫面的三分之一。圖片有多張，都是同一比例的直式圖片，每張約佔畫面寬的五分之一、高約半個畫面；圖片散落在文字塊左右兩側的空間（左側約在內容寬度的一成到三成之間，右側約在六成五到九成之間），一張在左、下一張在右，上下錯開，同一高度只有一張，每張的水平位置略有不同，不完全對齊。區塊剛出現時文字塊在上方，圖片從文字塊下方開始排列，不與文字並排；文字在區塊內固定在畫面上方約三分之一處後，圖片層正常捲動，由下往上從文字塊兩側經過，經過時圖片邊緣和文字重疊少許，文字在圖片前面。文字層和圖片層一樣高，圖片層較長；固定期間約捲動 3 個畫面高度，最後一張圖片經過文字旁之後解除固定，文字隨頁面捲走。
mobile: 取消固定，高度改為依內容而定，改為直向堆疊，只留文字：直排文字改為橫排，置中對齊，寬度接近頁面內容寬度；兩側的圖片全部隱藏。

en.name: Pinned centered vertical text + portrait images passing on alternating sides
en.desc: A block of vertical text stays fixed in the center of the screen while multiple portrait images, alternating left and right, scroll up past both sides of it; the pin ends after the last image has passed.
en.prompt: Create a section about four viewports tall, in which one column stays fixed in view while the other scrolls past: the text in the center stays fixed and the images on both sides scroll past normally. In the upper part of the section place a full block of text set vertically: multiple vertical lines placed side by side from right to left, forming one wide block of text that takes about thirty to forty percent of the page content width, roughly horizontally centered, with no title or button; the text block is about a third of the viewport tall. There are multiple images, all portrait with the same proportions, each about a fifth of the viewport width and about half a viewport tall; the images are scattered in the space on the left and right of the text block (on the left roughly between ten and thirty percent of the content width, on the right roughly between sixty-five and ninety percent), one on the left and the next on the right, staggered vertically so that only one image sits at any given height, and the horizontal position of each image varies slightly so they do not line up exactly. When the section first appears the text block is at the top and the images start below it, not beside the text; once the text is fixed within the section at about a third of the way down the viewport, the image layer scrolls normally and passes up along both sides of the text block, with the edge of a passing image overlapping the text slightly and the text in front of the image. The text layer and the image layer are the same height, with the image layer being longer; the pinned phase lasts about 3 viewport heights of scrolling, and after the last image has passed beside the text, the text unpins and scrolls away with the page.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The pin is removed and the height becomes determined by its content; the section becomes a vertical stack with only the text: the vertical text is set horizontally, centered, with a width close to the page content width; all images on the sides are hidden.
